hint.DATA_PACK: Taken as-is from the organiser's Data Pack (contracts, parties, milestones, events, payment_rules).
hint.SEED: The Data Pack has no such data (people, signing order, demo contracts...). Added by the team to run every flow, and marked.
hint.APP: Created by a user action in the app, recorded in the Data Pack schema.

policyHint.AUTO_IF_ALL_CONDITIONS: No approval; complete evidence makes it eligible.
policyHint.SINGLE_BUYER_APPROVAL: One approval by the contract owner.
policyHint.DUAL_APPROVAL: Two roles: contract owner and secondary approver.
policyHint.FINANCE_PLUS_OWNER: Two roles: contract owner and finance approver.

decisionHint.PENALTY: Eligible for payment after the late penalty
decisionHint.REJECT: Not payable: an authorised approver rejected it

reason.UNAUTHORIZED_EVENT: Evidence created by a party without authority
reason.LATE_COMPLETION: Completed after the due date and grace period
reason.UNRESOLVED_CONDITION: Cannot be evaluated automatically; held for review

next.REVIEW_EXCEPTION: The contract owner proposes how to handle the record filed by the wrong party; the organisation's controller checks it

ruleOutcome.OVERRIDDEN: Matched, but sent to ELSE by a data anomaly
ruleOutcome.SET_ASIDE: Matched, set aside by a safety check

errors.NOT_YOUR_EVENT_TYPE: The other party creates this document (authority matrix 4.2).
errors.EVIDENCE_ALREADY_ATTACHED: A file is already attached for this document.
errors.EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: Attach every document of your side before submitting.
errors.NOTHING_TO_SUBMIT: Your side has nothing left to submit.
errors.MILESTONE_CLOSED: The milestone is final (rejected or transferred); no more events.
errors.CONTRACT_NOT_SIGNED: The contract is not fully signed yet.
errors.NOT_AN_APPROVER: You are not an approver of this contract's buyer.
errors.NOT_A_REQUIRED_APPROVER: Your role is not one of the milestone's required approval roles.
errors.ALREADY_VOTED: You already recorded your decision on this milestone.
errors.CANNOT_OPEN_DISPUTE: You cannot open a dispute on this contract.
errors.CANNOT_RESOLVE_DISPUTE: Only the buyer or the contract owner may close a dispute.
errors.NOT_PAYABLE: The milestone is not eligible for payment.
errors.NOT_FINANCE_APPROVER: Only the buyer's finance approver can transfer.
errors.EVENT_NOT_VOIDABLE: Only unauthorised or anomalous events can be proposed for voiding (BR-19).
errors.SECOND_CONTROLLER_REQUIRED: The proposer cannot approve it; the organisation's controller has to check it (SoD-2).
errors.CONTROLLERS_ONLY: Only the organisation's controller can do this.
errors.CONTRACT_OWNER_ONLY: Only the contract owner can propose how to handle an exception.
errors.NO_OPEN_TASK: You have no task of this kind.
errors.UNKNOWN: That did not work. Try again later.
errors.ACTION_FORBIDDEN: Your role may not do this.
errors.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Your session has ended; sign in again.
errors.BUYER_EDITORS_ONLY: Only the contract owner or the buyer's contract officer can prepare a contract.
errors.BUYER_ONLY: Only the buyer can do this.
errors.CONTRACT_ACCESS_DENIED: This contract is outside your scope.
errors.CSV_OR_ZIP_REQUIRED: Only CSV or ZIP files are accepted.
errors.DATASET_NOT_EVALUATED: The dataset has not been evaluated yet.
errors.DRAFT_LOCKED: The terms are locked; the draft can no longer change.
errors.EVALUATION_NOT_FOUND: The milestone has no evaluation yet.
errors.IMAGE_NOT_ALLOWED: This contract needs a digital signature; a signature image is not accepted.
errors.INVALID_ANCHOR: The anchor bundle has an invalid structure or hash.
errors.INVALID_DATES: The end date must come after the start date.
errors.INVALID_RESOLUTION: Invalid way to settle the dispute.
errors.INVALID_REVIEWER: Choose an active contract officer from the buyer organization.
errors.NOT_ASSIGNED_SIGNER: This signing step is assigned to someone else.
errors.NOT_A_REQUIRED_EVENT: This milestone does not need that document.
errors.NOT_YOUR_TURN: It is not your turn to sign yet.
errors.REQUEST_NOT_PENDING: The signing request is no longer waiting for confirmation.
errors.SIGNERS_BOTH_SIDES: The signers must include both the buyer and the supplier.
errors.SIGNER_COUNT: Two to four signers are needed.
errors.SIGNING_NOT_FOUND: The contract has no signing order.
errors.UNKNOWN_OUTPUT: This output file does not exist.
errors.UNKNOWN_PARTY: The recording party is not in the Data Pack.
errors.INVALID_TITLE: Contract title must be at most 250 characters.
errors.AUDIT_CHAIN_BROKEN: The audit chain is broken; investigate before anchoring.
errors.WITNESS_UNAVAILABLE: The witness store could not be written or verified. Retry the job.
errors.DOCUMENT_CHANGED: Document or terms changed. Reload and start a new review or signing request.
errors.REQUEST_EXPIRED: The signing request expired. Start a new request.
errors.EXTRACTION_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: The extraction was already confirmed. Reload its current state.
errors.EXTRACTION_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Extract and confirm the uploaded document’s terms before locking.
errors.RULE_VERSION_INVALID: Invalid configuration: check the complete rule set, 100% workflow totals, events and permitted expressions.
errors.RULE_VERSION_LOCKED: This version is locked; create a new draft to change it.
errors.RULE_VERSION_AUTHOR_REQUIRED: Only the author can edit and submit this draft.
errors.RULE_VERSION_REGRESSION: Configuration changes baseline results or fails sample/business checks.
errors.RULE_VERSION_UNSAFE: The rule set failed the safety check: it can pay while a blocker holds or pay an amount out of range. Preview the impact and submit it again.
errors.SECOND_REVIEWER_REQUIRED: A different administrator must review and publish this version.
errors.SAMPLE_GENERATION_FAILED: The sample document could not be generated. Please retry.
errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The request exceeds the 4 MB limit. Reduce the payload size.
errors.INVALID_JSON: The JSON request body is invalid.
errors.DOCUMENT_PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE: The document could not be rendered.
errors.CONTRACT_TEMPLATE_INVALID: Invalid template. Check terms, amount limits and signer roles.
errors.CONTRACT_TEMPLATE_UNAVAILABLE: This template was disabled or deleted. Refresh the list.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: The record changed. Reload before applying the new version.
errors.DOCUMENT_REQUIRED: Store the actual contract document before issuing it.
errors.SIGNATURE_PROVIDER_ERROR: The signing provider has not returned valid evidence. Signing remains incomplete.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds the 20 MB limit.
errors.DUPLICATE_RECORD: A matching record or appendix name already exists. Rename the file or remove the previous entry first.
errors.ENGINE_INVARIANT_FAILED: The engine result violates business invariants. No changes were saved; review configuration and data.
errors.ENGINE_INVARIANT_VIOLATION: Engine results violate business or amount checks. The transaction was not saved; review rules and parameters.
errors.RULE_EVALUATION_FAILED: The formula is valid syntactically but cannot execute on the data (e.g. zero denominator or fractional days). Review parameters and preview again.
errors.EXTRACTION_CONFIG_INVALID: Invalid extraction configuration. Check the server provider, model and key.
errors.GEMINI_UNAVAILABLE: Document reading did not respond. Retry; your contract has not changed.
errors.GEMINI_RATE_LIMIT: Gemini quota reached. Wait or check the project quota and retry.
errors.GEMINI_AUTH_FAILED: Google denied server access. Check the API key and project permissions.
errors.GEMINI_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The configured Gemini model is unavailable. Select an accessible model on the server.
errors.GEMINI_INVALID_RESPONSE: AI output is incomplete or invalid. Retry or review the document.
errors.GEMINI_DOCUMENT_LIMIT: AI currently accepts PDF files up to 10 MB and 40 pages.
errors.GEMINI_DOCUMENT_REQUIRED: Upload and save an actual contract file before using AI.
errors.GEMINI_BUSY: Too many documents are being read. Retry shortly.
errors.SLOT_REQUIRED: Every signer needs a valid signature area on the document.
errors.SLOT_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: A signature area is outside its page or has invalid dimensions.
errors.SLOT_OVER_TEXT: A signature area covers contract text. Move it to blank space.
errors.SLOT_OVERLAP: Signature areas overlap. Give each signer a separate area.
errors.SIGNER_DOCUMENT_MISMATCH: The signer does not match the printed name/party. Check the signer list or regenerate the document.
errors.SLOT_WRONG_SIGNER_AREA: The box is outside this signer’s printed area. Select the correct area or use the suggestion.
errors.ENGINE_OUTPUT_INVALID: The engine response does not match the data contract or consistency checks. No changes were saved.
errors.ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: The configured engine is unavailable. Check the service; the system will not silently use another engine.
errors.DISPUTE_ALREADY_OPEN: This milestone already has an open dispute; a new one cannot be opened.
errors.PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND: The payment instruction was not found.
errors.ALREADY_DELIVERED: The payment gateway already accepted this instruction.
errors.TIMESTAMP_UNAVAILABLE: The time-stamp authority did not answer or returned an invalid stamp. Retry the job.
errors.EVIDENCE_FILE_MISSING: No stored file backs this attachment. Upload the file again.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_EVIDENCE_FILE: Evidence must be a PDF, a PNG/JPEG image, a Word (.docx) or an Excel (.xlsx) file.

ruleCondition.OPEN_DISPUTE: An open dispute puts the payment on hold.
ruleCondition.REJECTION_PRESENT: A valid rejection means the milestone is rejected and not paid.
ruleCondition.UNAUTHORIZED_EVENT: Evidence from a party without authority does not count; held for review.
ruleCondition.MISSING_REQUIRED_EVENT: Without all required evidence for the milestone, no payment is released.
ruleCondition.APPROVAL_QUORUM_NOT_MET: If approval is required but the roles or number of approvals are incomplete, payment is held.
ruleCondition.LATE_COMPLETION: Completed after the due date and grace period: a late penalty is deducted from the payment.
ruleCondition.ALL_CONDITIONS_MET: All conditions met, no dispute and no rejection: the full milestone value is paid.
ruleCondition.UNRESOLVED_CONDITION: Anything not covered above is held for manual review, never paid automatically.
